summary: BREAK: ops clarification imposes a global full-refund-within-24h-of-booking rule that contradicts provider-owned cancellation policies in original P1/P2. Clocks may also differ (booking time vs appointment time). Spec now contains two cancellation systems; neither was formally revoked.
evidence: Original: 'cancel bookings with the provider's cancellation policy applied' = P-F4/U-F8.
Update: 'all cancellations made within 24 hours of booking receive a full refund, regardless of the reason. Cancellations after 24 hours are non-refundable.'
Conflict example: cancel 2 days after booking and 10 hours before session — platform non-refundable vs provider session-relative 50%/full.
Open: override vs default vs more-generous; possible mis-edit of booking vs appointment clock.
Did not invent a winner in BREAK.
